source: Xiong et al. analyzed the two placements with mean-field theory. At initialization, they found large expected gradients near the output layers in the original Post-LN Transformer, motivating learning-rate warm-up, while the Pre-LN formulation had better-behaved gradients in their analysis and experiments. [5]
zh: 熊等人。用平均场理论分析了这两个位置。在初始化时，他们发现原始 Post-LN Transformer 中的输出层附近存在较大的预期梯度，从而激发了学习率预热，而 Pre-LN 公式在他们的分析和实验中具有更好的梯度表现。 [5]
